hook_line: GOLD BACK ABOVE $4,100 BEFORE CPI TEST

hook_stat.sub: Spot gold price on Monday, after Friday's payrolls surprise knocked it toward $4,033

stats.label: US jobs added in October, well above the 65,000 expected
US unemployment rate in October, down from 4.2% in September
Resistance range ahead of Tuesday's US CPI release

diaspora_bullets: Gold demand in India picked up as prices slid to a seven-month low
A hot CPI print could seal a December hike and revive gold selling
news_summary: Spot gold traded at $4,121.77 on Monday, rebounding above $4,100 after Friday's stronger-than-expected US payrolls report knocked it toward $4,033, with Tuesday's US CPI release now set to decide whether the rebound holds.
payoff: Gold absorbed a payrolls print nearly three times forecast and still closed the week about 5% higher, its largest weekly advance since late August.
